# Reverse parser admission: known legacy syntax and diagnostic recovery.
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:fork-block compiler VIP-17: a bare fork brace-body containing statements is not a UnaryExpression operand; the compiler wraps it in a program and accepts it; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:fork-block compiler VIP-17: bare fork block statements have no Appendix A derivation; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:for-concurrent-line-break compiler Appendix A: `concurrent` is a keyword only before `(` on the same line; a line break after `concurrent` still compiles as the loop; lane impl-hunt-admission

FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:effect-type-callback-second-bang-line-break compiler VIP-3: a callback return type also loses the no-LineTerminator restriction before its second effect-type bang

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:is-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7 and the pinned TC39 grammar: RelationalExpression [no LineTerminator here] `is` MatchPattern makes an is expression a RelationalExpression, which can't be the left operand of +, * or <<; the compiler reads `x is 1 + 1` as `(x is 1) + 1` and reports only TS2365; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:is-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7 and the pinned TC39 grammar: RelationalExpression [no LineTerminator here] `is` MatchPattern makes an is expression a RelationalExpression, which can't be the left operand of +, * or <<; the compiler reads `x is 1 + 1` as `(x is 1) + 1` and reports only TS2365; lane impl-hunt-admission
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:is-relational-operand-precedence compiler VIP-7: IsTest is a RelationalExpression; signed and relational pattern prefixes do not admit a following tighter arithmetic operator; type errors do not reject syntax

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:unhomed-pattern-subject compiler VIP-7 and VIP-17: an is binding with no lexical home discards its subject, hiding an outside-Effect fork or join prefix behind EK0705 even when the pattern grammar is valid
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:unhomed-pattern-subject-prefix compiler VIP-7 and VIP-17: an unhomed binding in a parameter default discards its outside-Effect join subject; the valid rest pattern receives only EK0705
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:mutable-default compiler VIP-15 preserves native writable defaults and adopts no mutable modifier: the parser still consumes a `mutable` member marker in type literals, interfaces, schemas and data payloads (EK3410 on an ordinary member) and Appendix A has no production for it; the registry rows Parser.parseVibeLangMutable and Parser.vibelangReadonly carry the same key

FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:ambient-custom-declaration compiler Appendix A: DeclareDeclaration lists only TypeScript's declarations, while chapters 13, 15 and 16 reject an explicit `declare error`, `declare schema` or `declare data` statically (EK1307, EK1506, EK1607), so the compiler parses the form that Appendix A does not derive
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:pattern-name-object compiler VIP-7 and the pinned draft: MatchPattern has MemberExpressionPattern (a chain or an extractor call) and ObjectPattern as separate alternatives and no `Name { … }` form; the compiler parses `when Address { let street }` and rejects it statically (EK0707 or EK0702)
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:pattern-super-element compiler VIP-7 and the pinned draft: PatternMatchingMemberExpression has `super . IdentifierName` only, while the compiler accepts and runs `when super[key]`
FuzzGrammarAdmission admission:catch-annotated-initializer compiler Appendix A: Catch takes a binding with an optional annotation and no initializer; TypeScript's parser takes an initializer and its checker skips TS1197 for an annotated binding, so `try {} catch (e: unknown = 1) {}` compiles with no diagnostic (stock 5.9.3 the same); the un-annotated form is TS1197
FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:catch-annotated-initializer compiler Appendix A: Catch takes a binding with an optional annotation and no initializer; TypeScript's parser takes an initializer and its checker skips TS1197 for an annotated binding, so `try {} catch (e: unknown = 1) {}` compiles with no diagnostic (stock 5.9.3 the same); the un-annotated form is TS1197

FuzzGrammarAdmission corpus:schema-jsdoc-dotted-generic compiler VIP-15: Field takes an ordinary source Type; the JSDoc dotted generic Array.<T> maps silently as a field type with no diagnostic, where TypeScript reports TS8020 (its prefix forms are admission:schema-jsdoc-field-type)
